test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

His parents will send him to a boarding school next year

options.text: He will be sent to a boarding school next year by his parents.
He will be sent to a boarding school by his parents next year.
He is to be sent to a boarding school next year by his parents.
He would be sent to a boarding school next year by his parents.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**He will be sent to a boarding school next year by his parents.**"
